cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle school, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little while. I'll stay home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring me your script, sweetheart. We'll do your scenes together.
